shape.description: Yellow hollow hood with flat vertical sides, open underneath. The back stands on a block (block-style feet) and is the tallest part; the roof falls in a convex curve from there to a low front edge that overhangs about 1.5 cells past the block. A row of small slits on the roof; warning-stripe stickers on the sides.
shape.sizeBasis: Rescaled from an earlier estimate of a 62 mm cell and 47 mm slot (IMG_0951, IMG_0952) to the grid scale (2026-11-07): one cell 45 mm, one slot 45.3 mm (B-01, src/catalog/parts.js). Lengths and widths times 45/62, height times 45.3/47; ratios to cell and slot are kept, the millimetres stay estimates.

accepts: marble launched up from below by the M-02 tube, which stands one cell from the tower
ports.catchBasis: radiusMm measured on models/M-06.glb (tests/models.test.js): the side walls' inner faces are 19.6 mm from the mouth axis over the marble's height at the mouth plane; less the marble's 10 mm radius, a marble centre up to 9.6 mm off the axis passes clear. halfAngleDeg is not measured.

marblePaths.viaBasis: The marble rises into the mouth, the sloped roof turns it back over the block, and it drops through the throat (behaviour). Drawn level at the mouth's height to over the throat, then down: the diagonal from mouth to throat ran through the rim of the B-02 under the hood.

physics.behaviour: A catcher, entered only from below. Stands on top of a tower one cell from the M-02 tube, its open underside over the tube's aim. A marble fired up into the overhang hits the roof, is turned back and falls through the throat into the B-02 under the hood, then rolls out its mouth. Does nothing for a rolling marble, and a marble dropped onto the roof from above bounces off.

evidence.source: lp_plans_12 step 3-12 and crop of lp_plans_15
evidence.shows: Placement 1: M-06 on a B-02 on top of the 6-block tower, z 7. T-08 leaves that B-02 to the rocket. The hood overhangs toward M-02's tube.
Placement 2: M-06 on a B-02 at A6, reaching across B6 to C6 over the tube of M-02. T-07 leaves the B-02 at A6 (arrows in step 7-9 extreme_60).
Part named M-06 with label 8 stripes on two faces.
flat sticker-covered sides, sloping roof, block-style legs at the back
sizeMm was 100 x 155 x 75 at a 62 mm cell; at the 45 mm cell it is 73 x 113 x 72, which matches footprintCells 1 x 2.5 and heightSlots 1.5
the hood has an entrance from below; balls shoot up into it and fall out the other side; the cannon must point at it
hood tower directly beside the M-02 tube, on the side away from the button: mouth one cell from the throat

assumptions: Origin at footprint centre at foot level (the top plane of whatever the piece stands on). East is +x, south is +y, z in slots.
Catcher role is inferred: both placements put it over the M-02 tube, on a B-02 that feeds a track. Nothing in the plans labels it.
Assumed that marble is steered down inside to the B-02 throat. The underside is not shown in any picture.
Height and overhang measured from the drawings only.
